on-error-propagate.type: APIKIT:BAD_REQUEST, APIKIT:NOT_FOUND, APIKIT:METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED, APIKIT:NOT_ACCEPTABLE, APIKIT:UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE, APIKIT:NOT_IMPLEMENTED, APP:DEVICE_NOT_FOUND

set-variable.value: #[{ BAD_REQUEST: 400, NOT_FOUND: 404, METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: 405, NOT_ACCEPTABLE: 406, UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: 415, NOT_IMPLEMENTED: 501, DEVICE_NOT_FOUND: 404 }[error.errorType.identifier] default 500]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: vars.httpStatus, error: error.errorType.identifier, message: error.description, timestamp: now() }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: 503, error: "SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE", message: "The database is currently unavailable. Please try again later.", timestamp: now() }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: 500, error: "INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR", message: "An unexpected error occurred. Please contact support.", timestamp: now() }

db:bulk-insert.doc:name: Bulk insert
db:bulk-insert.db:bulk-input-parameters: #[vars.readings map (item) -> { deviceId: item.deviceId, metricName: item.metricName, readingTimestamp: item.timestamp, metricValue: item.value, unit: item.unit, qualityFlag: item.qualityFlag, breachStatus: item.breachStatus default null, siteId: item.siteId default null, firmwareVersion: item.firmwareVersion default null, correlationId: item.correlationId default null }]
db:bulk-insert.db:sql: INSERT IGNORE INTO sensor_readings (device_id, metric_name, reading_timestamp, metric_value, unit, quality_flag, breach_status, site_id, firmware_version, correlation_id) VALUES (:deviceId, :metricName, :readingTimestamp, :metricValue, :unit, :qualityFlag, :breachStatus, :siteId, :firmwareVersion, :correlationId)

db:bulk-insert.doc:name: Upsert current value
db:bulk-insert.db:bulk-input-parameters: #[vars.goodReadings map (item) -> { deviceId: item.deviceId, metricName: item.metricName, metricValue: item.value, unit: item.unit, readingTimestamp: item.timestamp, breachStatus: item.breachStatus default null }]
db:bulk-insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO sensor_current_value (device_id, metric_name, metric_value, unit, reading_timestamp, breach_status) VALUES (:deviceId, :metricName, :metricValue, :unit, :readingTimestamp, :breachStatus) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE metric_value = IF(VALUES(reading_timestamp) > reading_timestamp, VALUES(metric_value), metric_value), unit = IF(VALUES(reading_timestamp) > reading_timestamp, VALUES(unit), unit), breach_status = IF(VALUES(reading_timestamp) > reading_timestamp, VALUES(breach_status), breach_status), reading_timestamp = IF(VALUES(reading_timestamp) > reading_timestamp, VALUES(reading_timestamp), reading_timestamp)

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { received: sizeOf(vars.readings), currentValueCandidates: sizeOf(vars.goodReadings default []) }

db:select.doc:name: Select device
db:select.db:sql: SELECT device_id, site_id, device_status, registered_at FROM device_registry WHERE device_id = :deviceId

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { deviceId: payload[0].device_id, siteId: payload[0].site_id, status: payload[0].device_status, registeredAt: payload[0].registered_at }
